market_summary: London morning session exhibits quiet consolidation on European FX pairs (EURUSD and GBPUSD) within their respective session Value Areas, respecting daily VWAP but lacking RVOL expansion or structural breakout momentum. BTCUSD remains in a disciplined intraday downtrend below its session VWAP, EMA50, and Value Area Low, offering a short continuation setup as it flags below local resistance.

signals.rationale: Evaluating 7-point checklist: 1) VP context shows price inside Value Area (VAL 1.10773 to VAH 1.10981) and trading just below POC 1.10946. 2) CVD is BULLISH (+3,587) with positive slope (+2,001.89), agreeing with upside drift. 3) Session is LONDON_SESSION, which is active and tradeable. 4) Price is holding above VWAP (1.10847) and above EMA50 (1.10878), establishing a steady intraday recovery. 5) Price is mid-to-upper ATR channel, not stretched at bands. 6) RVOL is 0.892 (no yellow spike), indicating normal consolidation rather than aggressive breakout volume. 7) Price is consolidating right under Session High (1.10988) and POC (1.10946) without a clear catalyst or breakout trigger. With price trapped inside VA right below POC and Session High resistance, risk/reward is unfavorable for chasing. Prudent action is HOLD.

signals.rationale: Evaluating 7-point checklist: 1) VP context shows price inside Value Area (VAL 1.32593 to VAH 1.32797) and below POC (1.32738). 2) CVD is BEARISH (-2,610) with positive slope (+774.22), showing conflict against the minor upward drift. 3) Session is LONDON_SESSION. 4) Price is hovering tightly between EMA50 (1.32693) and VWAP (1.32661), exhibiting no clear directional trend. 5) Signals printed a rejection upper wick near the +2 ATR upper band (1.32796) and Session High (1.32809). 6) RVOL is 1.039, normal volume with no yellow confirmation spikes. 7) Price failed to breach Session High (1.32809) and is oscillating inside the core session value area.
